scope: Hermetic local Git commit/push boundaries with fake provider facts, plus CLI parsing and MCP inventory/schema contracts

cases.proves: Actual target containment; no MERGE_HEAD, source rewrite or preparation push
Reviewed grant bytes, exactly one original-head parent, immutable original merge, literal no-force push arguments, stored validation and exact successor readback
Existing explicit agent-edit authority supports a new source file with bounded content/path receipt
Recorded-tree crash recovery succeeds; unrecorded or altered-tree manual commits refuse
Committed checkpoint and stale pre-lock session cannot be relabeled as editable work
Unchanged remote is not no-write evidence; uncertain intent cannot retry or delete its workspace
An authorized tree cannot justify an invented redundant merge parent
A concurrent source update is not overwritten by publication
No semantic opt-in on divergent target or force-capable policy
Failed Preparing merge record and WIP survive; refusal returns its real session identity
Version3/discriminator required; legacy/v2 reader and cleanup cannot decode; missing validation/policy/intent evidence refuses
No-op, ungranted/extra path, unstaged/untracked, wrong grant bytes, actor and implicit sync refusals
Failed or mutating validation, moved provider generation and moved live target stop publication
CLI requires non-force; actual router exposes distinct semantic tool, no request force/purpose toggle
Existing merge repair, two-parent authored-history preservation, writer fences and response-loss guards remain exercised

not_proved_by_this_artifact: Containing release or installed runtime capability
Consumer source publication, new-head CI, queue admission or merge
